annotation.interpretation_a: The TCP implementation must eventually discard any buffered data if it cannot be sent, even if the application hasn't signaled completion.
annotation.interpretation_b: The TCP implementation must limit the amount of time it will buffer data, but may retry sending indefinitely as long as resources allow.
annotation.justification: The phrase "indefinitely" is not defined. It is unclear whether it means 'forever' or 'for an unbounded amount of time'. This affects how a TCP implementation would handle buffering and resource allocation.
annotation.missing_information: The definition of 'indefinitely' is missing. A time limit, resource limit, or application signal could resolve the ambiguity.
